_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: You're the one decision I'd make a thousand times over, without a second thought. You are the kind of beauty that artists dream of capturing. If fate exists, it showed up in my life as you.
